Prices, stock status and links are a snapshot from 2026-11-02. They are not updated unless the user explicitly asks for it, so check them before ordering.
Prices include VAT 25.5 %. Rows without a price: not sold at partco.fi or not looked up. Links: see parts-list.csv.
